description: Other Labourers includes a wide variety of occupations such as Bicycle Mechanics, Car Park Attendants, Crossing Supervisors, Electrical or Telecommunications Trades Assistants, Leaflet or Newspaper Deliverers, Mechanic's Assistants, Railways Assistants, Sign Erectors, Ticket Collectors or Ushers, Trolley Collectors and Road Traffic Controllers.

title: Corporate General Managers
description: Corporate General Managers manage commercial, industrial, governmental or other organisations through departmental managers and subordinate executives.

title: Defence Force Senior Officers
description: Defence Force Senior Officers manage organisational units of the Australian Defence Force through subordinate officers.

title: Local Government Legislators
description: Local Government Legislators represent the interests of people in a constituency as their elected member of a local government authority.

title: Members of Parliament
description: Members of Parliament represent the interests of people in a constituency as their elected member to national, state or territory parliament.

title: Other Legislators
description: Other Legislators includes jobs like Aboriginal Community Council Member and Councillor on an Aboriginal Land Council.

title: Cotton Growers
description: Cotton Growers manage planting, cultivating and harvesting activities to grow cotton plants.

title: Flower Growers
description: Flower Growers manage planting, cultivating and harvesting activities to grow flowering and foliage plants.

title: Fruit and Nut Growers
description: Fruit or Nut Growers manage planting, cultivating and harvesting activities to grow fruit and nuts.

description: Geologists study the composition, structure and other physical attributes of the earth to increase scientific knowledge and to develop practical applications in fields such as mineral exploitation, civil engineering, environmental protection and rehabilitation of land after mining.

title: Geophysicists
description: Geophysicists study the composition, structure and other physical attributes of the earth, locate minerals, petroleum or ground water, and detect, monitor and forecast seismic, magnetic, electrical, geothermal and oceanographic activity.

title: Hydrogeologists
description: Hydrogeologists monitor, measure, analyse and describe the earth's surface and groundwater resources and many aspects of the water cycle, including human use of water resources.

title: Biologists
description: Biologists study the origin, anatomy, physiology, reproduction and behaviour of living organisms and the ways in which they interact with the environment in which they live.

title: Biochemists
description: Biochemists study the biochemistry of living organisms and the molecular structure and function of related components.

title: Biotechnologists
description: Biotechnologists study the anatomy, physiology and characteristics of living organisms and isolated biological molecules, and develop new materials for applying to a range of purposes.

title: Botanists
description: Botanists study the anatomy, physiology, biochemistry and ecology of plants.

title: Marine Biologists
description: Marine Biologists study the anatomy, physiology, functions, characteristics, behaviour and environments of all forms of life living in the sea and connected water bodies.

title: Microbiologists
description: Microbiologists study microscopic forms of life such as bacteria, viruses and protozoa.

title: Zoologists
description: Zoologists study the anatomy, physiology, characteristics, ecology, behaviour and environments of animals.

title: Other Life Scientists
description: Other Life Scientists includes jobs like Anatomist, Animal Behaviourist, Neuroscientist, Parasitologist, Pharmacologist (Non-clinical), Physiologist, and Toxicologist.

title: Conservators
description: Conservators plan and organise the conservation of materials and objects in libraries, archives, museums, art galleries and other institutions.

title: Metallurgists
description: Metallurgists research, develop, control and provide advice on processes used in extracting metals from their ores, and processes used for casting, alloying, heat treating or welding refined metals, alloys and other materials to produce commercial metal products or develop new alloys and processes.

title: Meteorologists
description: Meteorologists study the physics and dynamics of the atmosphere to increase understanding of weather and climate, and to forecast changes in the weather and long-term climatic trends.

title: Physicists (including Astronomers)
description: Physicists (including Astronomers) study matter, space, time, energy, forces and fields and the interrelationship between these physical phenomena to further understand the laws governing the behaviour of the universe, and seek to apply these laws to solve practical problems and discover new information about the earth and the universe.

title: Exercise Physiologists
description: Exercise Physiologists assess, plan and implement exercise programs for preventing and managing chronic diseases and injuries, such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, osteoporosis, depression, cancer and arthritis, and assist in restoring optimal physical function, and health and wellness.

title: Natural and Physical Science Professionals (not covered elsewhere)
description: Natural and Physical Science Professionals (not covered elsewhere) include jobs like Materials Scientist, Metrologist, Polymer Scientist, Respiratory Scientist, and Sleep Scientist.

title: Special Needs Teachers
description: Special Needs Teachers teach academic and living skills to primary, middle or intermediate, and secondary school students with particular learning difficulties using various techniques.

title: Teachers of the Hearing Impaired
description: Teachers of the Hearing Impaired teach academic and living skills to hearing impaired students.

title: Teachers of the Sight Impaired
description: Teachers of the Sight Impaired teach academic and living skills to sight impaired students.

title: Other Special Education Teachers
description: Other Special Education Teachers includes jobs like Aboriginal Education Teacher and Distance Education Teacher.

title: University Lecturers
description: University Lecturers lecture students and conduct tutorials in one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at a university and conduct research in a particular field of knowledge.

title: University Tutors
description: University Tutors conduct tutorials in one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at a university.

title: Education Advisers
description: Education Advisers conduct educational research and develop course curricula and associated teaching materials for use by educational institutions.

title: Education Reviewers
description: Education Reviewers review and examine the work of teachers in classrooms and schools, and observe the results of the application of curriculum programs in primary, middle or intermediate school, or secondary educational institutions.

title: Art Teachers (Private Tuition)
description: Art Teachers (Private Tuition) teach art in private training establishments.

title: Dance Teachers (Private Tuition)
description: Dance Teachers (Private Tuition) teach dance in private training establishments.

title: Drama Teachers (Private Tuition)
description: Drama Teachers (Private Tuition) teach drama in private training establishments.

title: Music Teachers (Private Tuition)
description: Music Teachers (Private Tuition) teach music in private training establishments.

title: Other Private Tutors and Teachers
description: Other Private Tutors and Teachers includes jobs like Dressmaking Teacher (Private Tuition), Handicrafts Teacher (Private Tuition), Language Tutor (Private Tuition), and Maths Tutor (Private Tuition).

title: Dietitians
description: Dietitians apply the science of human nutrition to help people understand the relationship between food and health, how to make appropriate dietary choices to attain and maintain health, and how to prevent and treat illness and disease.

title: Nutritionists
description: Nutritionists integrate, disseminate and apply knowledge drawn from the relevant sciences to enhance positive effects of food on the health and well-being of human populations.

title: Medical Diagnostic Radiographers
description: Medical Diagnostic Radiographers operate X-rays and other medical imaging equipment to produce images for medical diagnostic purposes in conjunction with Diagnostic and Interventional Radiologists or other Medical Practitioners.

title: Medical Radiation Therapists
description: Medical Radiation Therapists operate high energy X-rays and other radiation and electron generating and monitoring equipment, to administer radiation treatment for medical purposes in conjunction with Radiation Oncologists or Other Specialist Medical Practitioners.

title: Nuclear Medicine Technologists
description: Nuclear Medicine Technologists perform or assist in performing diagnostic examinations using radionuclides and radiopharmaceuticals, and administer radionuclides and radiopharmaceuticals for therapeutic purposes under the direction of Specialist Medical Practitioners.

title: Sonographers
description: Sonographers operate ultrasound equipment to acquire, interpret and selectively record anatomical images, physical data and real-time physiological information for medical diagnostic purposes in conjunction with Medical Practitioners.

title: Environmental Health Officers
description: Environmental Health Officers develop, enforce and evaluate environmental health policies, programs and strategies to improve health outcomes, and oversee the implementation and monitoring of environmental health legislation.

title: Occupational Health and Safety Advisers
description: Occupational Health and Safety Advisers develop, implement and evaluate risk management policies and programs, train employees in occupational health and safety procedures, monitor and audit the workplace, and record and investigate incidents to ensure safe and healthy working conditions.

title: Optometrists
description: Optometrists perform eye examinations and vision tests to determine the presence of visual, ocular and other abnormalities, ocular diseases and systemic diseases with ocular manifestations, and prescribe lenses, other optical aids, therapy and medication to correct and manage vision problems and eye diseases.

title: Orthoptists
description: Orthoptists diagnose and manage eye movement disorders and associated sensory deficiencies.

title: Hospital Pharmacists
description: Hospital Pharmacists prepare and dispense pharmaceuticals, drugs and medicines in a hospital pharmacy.

title: Industrial Pharmacists
description: Industrial Pharmacists undertake research, testing and analysis related to the development, production, storage, quality control and distribution of drugs and related supplies.

title: Retail Pharmacists
description: Retail Pharmacists dispense prescribed pharmaceuticals to the public, educate customers on health promotion, disease prevention and the proper use of medicines, and sell non-prescription medicines and related goods in a community pharmacy.

title: Health Promotion Officers
description: Health Promotion Officers assist health and community groups to improve the health of individuals and the community by raising awareness of healthy lifestyles, disease and disability, and other health-related issues.

title: Orthotists and Prosthetists
description: Orthotists or Prosthetists design, build, fit and repair splints, braces, callipers, artificial limbs and related appliances to restore function or compensate for muscular and skeletal disabilities.

title: Genetic Counsellors (and Other Health Professionals not covered elsewhere)
description: Genetic Counsellors (and Other Health Professionals not covered elsewhere) includes jobs like Genetic Counsellor.

title: Chiropractors
description: Chiropractors diagnose and treat physiological and mechanical disorders of the human locomotor system, particularly neuromuscular skeletal disorders, and provide advice on preventing these disorders.

title: Osteopaths
description: Osteopaths diagnose and treat tissue strains, stresses and dysfunctions which impede normal neural, vascular and biochemical mechanisms, and provide advice on preventing these disorders.

title: Acupuncturists
description: Acupuncturists treat disorders and illnesses by stimulating the body's defence mechanisms through inserting fine needles into the skin.

title: Homoeopaths
description: Homoeopaths treat the body's immune and defence systems by assessing the whole person and using minute amounts of natural remedies made from substances such as plants, minerals and animal sources.

title: Naturopaths
description: Naturopaths treat internal health problems, metabolic disorders and imbalances through treatment of the whole person using natural therapies.

title: Chinese Medicine Practitioners
description: Chinese Medicine Practitioners treat imbalances of energy flows through the body by assessing the whole person and using techniques and methods such as acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, massage, diet, exercise and breathing therapy.

title: Music, Dance, Drama, Play, Hypnotic, and Related Therapists
description: Music, Dance, Drama, Play, Hypnotic, and Related Therapists includes jobs like Dance Therapist, Drama Therapist, Hypnotherapist, Music Therapist, and Play Therapist.

title: Dental Specialists (including Orthodontists)
description: Dental Specialists (including Orthodontists) diagnose and treat diseases, injuries, irregularities and malformations of teeth and associated structures in the mouth and jaw using surgery and other specialist techniques.

title: Dentists
description: Dentists diagnose and treat dental disease, injuries, decay and malformations of the teeth, periodontal tissue (gums), hard and soft tissue found on the mouth and other dento-facial structures using surgery and other techniques.

title: Audiologists
description: Audiologists provide diagnostic assessment and rehabilitative services related to human hearing defects.

title: Speech Pathologists
description: Speech Pathologists provide diagnostic assessment and management of disorders of communication and swallowing through direct intervention, education, consultancy, advocacy, or a combination of these approaches.

title: General Practitioners
description: General Practitioners diagnose, treat and prevent human physical and mental disorders and injuries.

title: Resident Medical Officers
description: Resident Medical Officers diagnose, treat and prevent human physical and mental disorders and injuries under the supervision of medical specialists or senior general practitioners.

title: Specialist Physicians (General Medicine)
description: Specialist Physicians (General Medicine) investigate and diagnose internal human disorders and diseases, and administer treatment.

title: Cardiologists
description: Cardiologists investigate, diagnose and treat diseases of the human heart.

title: Clinical Haematologists
description: Clinical Haematologists investigate and diagnose blood and other genetic disorders by studying cellular composition of blood and blood-producing tissues.

title: Medical Oncologists
description: Medical Oncologists investigate, diagnose and treat patients with cancer using chemotherapy and biological therapy.

title: Endocrinologists
description: Endocrinologists investigate, diagnose and treat disorders of the human glandular and hormonal systems.

title: Gastroenterologists
description: Gastroenterologists investigate, diagnose and treat diseases and disorders of the human liver, stomach and associated organs.

title: Intensive Care Specialists
description: Intensive Care Specialists investigate, diagnose and treat patients in need of intensive and critical care.

title: Neurologists
description: Neurologists investigate, diagnose and treat diseases and injuries of the human brain, spinal cord, nervous system and muscle tissue.

title: Paediatricians
description: Paediatricians investigate, diagnose and treat internal diseases and disorders in children from birth up to, and including, adolescence.

title: Renal Medicine Specialists
description: Renal Medicine Specialists investigate, diagnose and treat disorders of the human kidney.

title: Rheumatologists
description: Rheumatologists investigate, diagnose and treat diseases, injuries and deficiencies of human joints, muscles and soft tissue.

title: Thoracic Medicine Specialists
description: Thoracic Medicine Specialists investigate, diagnose and treat diseases and disorders of the human respiratory system.

title: Other Specialist Physicians
description: Other Specialist Physicians includes jobs like Clinical Allergist, Clinical Geneticist, Clinical Immunologist, Clinical Pharmacologist, Geriatrician, Infectious Diseases Physician, Occupational Medicine Physician, Palliative Medicine Physician, Public Health Physician, Rehabilitation Medicine Physician, Sexual Health Physician, and Sleep Medicine Physician.

title: Surgeons (General)
description: Surgeons (General) perform surgery to correct diseases and disorders covering a broad range of medical conditions.

title: Cardiothoracic Surgeons
description: Cardiothoracic Surgeons perform heart and lung surgery.

title: Neurosurgeons
description: Neurosurgeons perform surgery to correct disorders of the brain, spine and nervous system.

title: Orthopaedic Surgeons
description: Orthopaedic Surgeons perform surgery to treat muscular and skeletal diseases and injuries.

title: Ear, Nose and Throat Specialists
description: Ear, Nose and Throat Specialists perform surgery to correct diseases and disorders of the ear, nose and throat.

title: Paediatric Surgeons
description: Paediatric Surgeons provide surgical care and treatment to children from birth up to, and including, adolescence.

title: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons
description: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons perform surgery to repair and reconstruct muscle and tissue injuries and congenital deformities.

title: Urologists
description: Urologists provide medical and surgical treatment to patients with disorders of the kidney, urinary bladder and urethra, and treat disorders of the male sex organs.

title: Vascular Surgeons
description: Vascular Surgeons perform surgery to treat patients with conditions affecting their arteries and veins.

title: Dermatologists
description: Dermatologists provide diagnostic, treatment and preventative medical services related to disorders of the human skin.

title: Emergency Medicine Specialists
description: Emergency Medicine Specialists provide diagnostic medical services, and manage patients with acute and urgent illness and injury.

title: Obstetricians and Gynaecologists
description: Obstetrician and Gynaecologists provide diagnostic, treatment and preventative medical and surgical services related to the care of women, foetuses and children during pregnancy and childbirth, and to disorders of the female genital, urinary, rectal and reproductive organs.

title: Eye Specialists
description: Eye Specialists provide diagnostic, treatment and preventative medical services related to diseases, injuries and deficiencies of the human eye and associated structures.

title: Pathologists
description: Pathologists identify the cause and processes of disease and illness by examining changes in body tissue and in blood and other body fluids, and conduct tests on samples of tissues, blood and body secretions.

title: Diagnostic and Interventional Radiologists
description: Diagnostic and Interventional Radiologists provide diagnostic and treatment medical services, and monitor patients with various diseases utilising imaging techniques such as general radiography, angiography, fluoroscopy, mammography, ultrasound, computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, nuclear medicine and bone densitometry.

title: Radiation Oncologists
description: Radiation Oncologists provide medical care and management of patients with cancer and other medical conditions through the conduct and supervision of radiation treatment, and provide advice on the provision of palliative and other supportive care of patients with cancer.

title: Medical Practitioners (not covered elsewhere)
description: Medical Practitioners (not covered elsewhere) includes jobs like Nuclear Medicine Physician, and Sports Physician.

title: Nurse Educators
description: Nurse Educators design, plan, implement and evaluate the delivery of nursing education and staff development programs, and manage educational resources.

title: Nurse Researchers
description: Nurse Researchers design, conduct and evaluate nursing and interdisciplinary research projects, and promote the implementation of research findings into clinical nursing practice.

title: Nurse Practitioners
description: Nurse Practitioners provide advanced and extended nursing care to patients, such as ordering diagnostic tests, undertaking diagnosis and health assessments, prescribing patient care management, medicines and therapies, as authorised in relevant nursing legislation, and referring to specialist Medical Practitioners and other Health Professionals in a range of health, welfare and community settings.

title: Registered Nurses (Aged Care)
description: Registered Nurses (Aged Care) provide nursing care to the elderly in community settings, residential aged care facilities, retirement villages and health care facilities.

title: Registered Nurses (Child and Family Health)
description: Registered Nurses (Child and Family Health) provide nursing care to children and their families, with an emphasis on the prevention, early detection of, and early intervention in, physical, emotional and social problems affecting children and their families.

title: Registered Nurses (Community Health)
description: Registered Nurses (Community Health) provide nursing care, health counselling, screening and education to individuals, families and groups in the wider community with a focus on patient independence and health promotion.

title: Registered Nurses (Critical Care and Emergency)
description: Registered Nurses (Critical Care and Emergency) provide nursing care to critically ill patients and patients with unstable health following injury, surgery or during the acute phase of diseases, integrating new technological equipment into care in settings such as high dependency units, intensive care units, emergency departments or retrieval services.

title: Registered Nurses (Developmental Disability)
description: Registered Nurses (Developmental Disability) provide nursing care to people with intellectual and development disabilities in a range of health, welfare and community settings.

title: Registered Nurses (Disability and Rehabilitation)
description: Registered Nurses (Disability and Rehabilitation) provide nursing care to patients recovering from injury and illness, and assist and facilitate patients with disabilities to live more independently.

title: Registered Nurses (Medical)
description: Registered Nurses (Medical) provide nursing care to patients with conditions such as infections, metabolic disorders and degenerative conditions, which require medical intervention in a range of health, aged care and community settings.

title: Registered Nurses (Medical Practice)
description: Registered Nurses (Medical Practice) provide clinical care to patients, undertake clinical organisation and practice administration, and facilitate communication within a general practice environment and between the practice and outside organisations and individuals.

title: Registered Nurses (Mental Health)
description: Registered Nurses (Mental Health) provide nursing care to patients with mental health illness, disorder and dysfunction, and those experiencing emotional difficulties, distress and crisis in health, welfare and aged care facilities, correctional services and the community.

title: Registered Nurses (Perioperative)
description: Registered Nurses (Perioperative) provide nursing care to patients before, during and immediately after surgery, assess patients' condition, plan nursing care for surgical intervention, maintain a safe and comfortable environment, assist Surgeons and Anaesthetists during surgery, and monitor patients' recovery from anaesthetic, prior to return to, or discharge from, ward.

title: Registered Nurses (Surgical)
description: Registered Nurses (Surgical) provide nursing care to patients with injuries and illness that require surgical intervention.

title: Registered Nurses (Paediatrics)
description: Registered Nurses (Paediatrics) provide nursing care to children of all ages, including neonates, across a range of health and community settings with an emphasis on assessing children’s acute and ongoing needs while taking into account physical, social, cultural and family circumstances.

title: Registered Nurses (not covered elsewhere)
description: Registered Nurses (not covered elsewhere) includes jobs like Flight Nurse, Nursing Officer (Defence Forces), Registered Nurse (Infection Control), and Registered Nurse (Remote or Rural Area).

title: ICT Business Analysts
description: ICT Business Analysts identify and communicate with users to formulate and produce requirements specifications to create system and software solutions.

title: Systems Analysts
description: Systems Analysts evaluate processes and methods used in existing ICT systems, propose modifications and additional system components or new systems to meet user needs, as expressed in specifications and other documentation.

title: Game and Multimedia Developers
description: Game and Multimedia Developers create and manipulate computer animation, audio, video and graphic image files into multimedia programs to produce data and content for CD-ROMs, information kiosks, multimedia presentations, websites, mobile telephone resources, electronic gaming environments, e-commerce and e-security solutions, and entertainment and education products.

title: Web Developers
description: Web Developers plan, produce and maintain websites using web programming languages, software applications, technologies and databases together with specifications of user needs, often in conjunction with other ICT Professionals such as Business Analysts, Web Designers and network and usability specialists.

title: Analyst Programmers
description: Analyst Programmers analyse user needs, produce requirements documentation and system plans, and encode, test, debug, maintain and document programs and applications.

title: Developer Programmers
description: Developer Programmers interpret specifications, technical designs and flow charts, build, maintain and modify the code for software applications, construct technical specifications from a business functional model, and test and write technical documentation.

title: Software Engineers
description: Software Engineers design, develop, modify, document, test, implement, install and support software applications and systems.

title: Software Testers
description: Software Testers specify, develop and write test plans and test scripts, produce test cases, carry out regression testing, and use automated test software applications to test the behaviour, functionality and integrity of computer software, and document the results of tests in defect reports and related documentation.

title: Other Software and Applications Programmers
description: This occupation group covers Other Software and Applications Programmers not elsewhere classified. Occupations in this group include jobs like Software Tester.

title: Database Administrators
description: Database Administrators plan, develop, configure, maintain and support an organisation's database management system in accordance with user requirements, ensuring optimal database integrity, security, backup, reliability and performance.

title: ICT Security Specialists
description: ICT Security Specialists establish, manage and administer organisation's ICT security policies and procedures to ensure preventive and recovery strategies are in place, and to minimise the risk of internal and external security threats.

title: Systems Administrators
description: System Administrators plan, develop, install, troubleshoot, maintain and support operating systems and associated server hardware, software and databases ensuring optimum system integrity, security, backup and performance.

title: Computer Network and Systems Engineers
description: Computer Network and Systems Engineers plan, develop, deploy, test and optimise network and system services, taking responsibility for configuration management and overall operational readiness of network systems, especially environments with multiple operating systems and configurations, and provide troubleshooting and fault-finding services for network problems.

title: Network Administrators
description: Network Administrators install and maintain hardware and software, document diagnosis and resolution of faults, manage user passwords, security and inventory documentation, ensure the efficient performance of servers, printers and personal computers, and attend to other operational tasks. They may also perform tasks such as help desk support and user training.

title: Network Analysts
description: Network Analysts research and analyse network architecture, and recommend policies and strategies for designing, planning and coordinating an organisation's network, such as the total system environment and architecture. They may also perform operational tasks such as monitoring system performance, software and hardware upgrades, backups, support and network maintenance.

title: ICT Quality Assurance Engineers
description: ICT Quality Assurance Engineers create, maintain and manage technical quality assurance processes and procedures to assess efficiency, validity, value and functional performance of computer systems and environments, and audit systems to ensure compliance with, and adherence to, accredited internal and external industry quality standards and regulations. They may supervise the work of ICT quality assurance teams.

title: ICT Support Engineers
description: ICT Support Engineers develop support procedures and strategies for systems, networks, operating systems and applications development, solve problems and provide technical expertise and direction in support of system infrastructure and process improvements, and diagnose and resolve complex system problems.

title: ICT Systems Test Engineers
description: ICT System Test Engineers specify, develop and write test plans and test scripts, produce test cases, carry out regression testing, and use automated test software applications to test the behaviour, functionality and integrity of systems, and document the results of tests in defect reports and related documentation.

title: Other ICT Support and Test Engineers
description: Other ICT Support and Test Engineers includes jobs like Usability Architect.

title: Telecommunications Engineers
description: Telecommunication Engineers design and develop telecommunications systems, devices and products.

title: Telecommunications Network Engineers
description: Telecommunication Network Engineers plan, design, and monitor complex telecommunications networks and associated broadcasting equipment.

title: Judges
description: Judges preside over civil and criminal proceedings in courts of law.

title: Magistrates
description: Magistrates hear criminal matters to determine whether defendants will be committed for trial, and adjudicate minor criminal offences without a jury.

title: Tribunal Members
description: Tribunal Members hear industrial, administrative or other disputes to assist in resolving differences and to arbitrate on issues.

title: Intellectual Property Lawyers
description: Intellectual Property Lawyers provide legal advice, prepare and draft legal documents, and conduct negotiations on behalf of clients on matters associated with protecting intellectual capital, utilising patent law, copyright law and licensing.

title: Judicial and Other Legal Professionals (not covered elsewhere)
description: Judicial and Other Legal Professionals (not covered elsewhere) includes jobs like Family Court Registrar, Family Law Mediator, Judicial Registrar, Legal Researcher, Legal Officer, and Parliamentary Counsel.

title: Careers Counsellors
description: Careers Counsellors provide individuals and groups with information about career choices and assist individuals with self-development.

title: Drug and Alcohol Counsellors
description: Drug and Alcohol Counsellors provide support and treatment for people with drug and alcohol dependency problems, develop strategies which assist them to set goals and affect and maintain change, and provide community education. They may work in call centres.

title: Family and Marriage Counsellors
description: Family and Marriage Counsellors assist individuals, couples and families with marriage and relationship difficulties. They may work in call centres.

title: Rehabilitation Counsellors
description: Rehabilitation Counsellors assist physically, mentally and socially disadvantaged people to reintegrate into work and the community.

title: Student Counsellors
description: Student Counsellors provide information and assistance to students, parents and teachers about a wide range of matters, such as students' personal problems, learning difficulties and special requirements.

title: Other Counsellors and Life Coaches
description: Other Counsellors and Life Coaches includes jobs like Gambling Counsellor, Grief Counsellor, Life Coach, Sexual Assault Counsellor, and Trauma Counsellor. Occupations in this group may work in call centres.

title: Clinical Psychologists
description: Clinical Psychologists consult with individuals and groups, assess psychological disorders and administer programs of treatment.

title: Educational Psychologists
description: Educational Psychologists investigate learning and teaching, and develop psychological techniques to foster the development and skills of individuals and groups in educational settings.

title: Organisational Psychologists
description: Organisational Psychologists apply psychological principles and techniques to study occupational behaviour, working conditions and organisational structure, and solve problems of work performance and organisational design.

title: Psychotherapists
description: Psychotherapists provide diagnosis and treatment of mental and emotional disorders using psychotherapeutic methods such as behavioural therapy, biofeedback, relaxation therapy and other techniques.

title: Other Psychologists
description: Other Psychologists includes jobs like Counselling Psychologist and Sport Psychologist.

title: Historians
description: Historians research the history of human activity and prepare accounts of findings.

title: Interpreters
description: Interpreters transfer spoken or signed languages into other spoken or signed languages, usually within a limited timeframe in the presence of the participants requiring the translation.

title: Translators
description: Translators transfer source texts from one language into another, usually within an extended time frame to allow for corrections and modifications and without the presence of the participants requiring the translation.

title: Archaeologists
description: Archaeologists study human activity in the past, primarily through the recovery and analysis of the material culture and environmental data left behind, which includes artefacts, architecture, biofacts and cultural landscapes (the archaeological record).

title: Other Social Professionals
description: Other Social Professionals includes jobs like Anthropologist, Criminologist, Geographer, Heritage Consultant, Linguist, Parole Board Member, Political Scientist, Sociologist, and Transport Analyst.

title: Community Arts Workers
description: Community Arts Workers identify issues of local need, concerns and aspirations through community consultation, and design and implement strategies to facilitate and encourage community arts projects and happenings, and promote the value of community cultural development.

title: Recreation Officers
description: Recreation Officers plan, organise and coordinate recreation facilities and programs through organisations such as local governments, schools, church bodies and youth organisations.

title: Welfare Workers
description: Welfare Workers assist individuals, families and groups with social, emotional or financial difficulties to improve quality of life, by educating and supporting them and working towards change in their social environment.

title: Anaesthetic Technicians
description: Anaesthetic Technicians prepare and maintain anaesthetic equipment for operating theatres or clinics, and assist Anaesthetists during anaesthetic procedures.

title: Cardiac Technicians
description: Cardiac Technicians conduct tests on patients to record heart activity using specialised equipment, recording devices and laboratory instruments in support of Cardiologists and other Medical Practitioners engaged in diagnosing, monitoring and treating heart disease.

title: Medical Laboratory Technicians
description: Medical Laboratory Technicians perform routine medical laboratory tests and operate diagnostic laboratory equipment under the supervision of Medical Laboratory Scientists and Pathologists.

title: Operating Theatre Technicians
description: Operating Theatre Technicians prepare and maintain operating theatres and their equipment, assist the surgical team during operations and provide support to patients in the recovery room.

title: Pharmacy Technicians
description: Pharmacy Technicians fill and label patients' prescriptions under the supervision of Pharmacists. They may record details of, place orders for, take stock of, and store medications and medical supplies and deliver them to patients.

title: Pathology Collectors
description: Pathology Collectors extract, collect, label and preserve blood and other specimens from patients for laboratory analysis.

title: Other Medical Technicians
description: Other Medical Technicians includes jobs like Audiometrist, Dialysis Technician, Electroencephalographic Technician, Mortuary Technician, Neurophysiological Technician, Orthotic and Prosthetic Technician, Ophthalmic Technician, Perfusionist, Renal Technician, Respiratory Technician, and Sleep Technician.

title: Fisheries Officers
description: Fisheries Officers inspect fishing vessels, gear, licences and catches to ensure that fisheries laws and regulations are obeyed.

title: Meat Inspectors
description: Meat Inspectors inspect animal carcasses, internal organs and meat processing facilities for disease to ensure compliance with government and industry standards with respect to quality and health.

title: Quarantine Officers
description: Quarantine Officers inspect incoming animals, plants, and animal and plant products to ensure compliance with laws and regulations to prevent the spread of exotic pests and diseases.

title: Other Primary Products Inspectors
description: Other Primary Products Inspectors includes jobs like Dairy Quality Assurance Officer, and Fruit and Vegetable Inspector.

title: Chemistry Technicians
description: Chemistry Technicians perform laboratory tests on organic and inorganic chemicals, analyse test data and carry out technical functions in support of Chemists or Chemical Engineers in a wide variety of areas such as fuels, agricultural products, food, pharmaceuticals, paints, metals, plastics, textiles, detergents, paper, fertilisers and cosmetics.

title: Earth Science Technicians
description: Earth Science Technicians collect and test earth and water samples, record observations and analyse data in support of Geologists or Geophysicists.

title: Life Science Technicians
description: Life Science Technicians identify and collects living organisms and conducts field and laboratory studies in support of Life Scientists or Environmental Scientists.

title: School Laboratory Technicians
description: School Laboratory Technicians prepare experiments and demonstrations, make up solutions, prepare slides, order books and equipment, and tidy up laboratories in support of teaching chemistry, earth sciences, life sciences and physical sciences.

title: Hydrographers
description: Hydrographers measure, analyse and maintain the flow and quality of water in rivers, lakes, stormwater and sewage, and survey and map oceans, seas and rivers.

title: Other Science Technicians
description: Other Science Technicians includes jobs like Calibration Technician, Fibre Technologist, Optics Technical Officer, Physics Technical Officer, and Textile Technical Officer.

title: Architectural Draftspersons
description: Architectural Draftspersons complete Architects' concepts by preparing drawings and plans, and liaising with builders and contractors.

title: Building Associates
description: Building Associates supervise construction sites, and organise and coordinate the material and human resources required.

title: Building Inspectors
description: Building Inspectors inspect buildings to ensure compliance with laws and regulations and advise on building requirements.

title: Construction Estimators
description: Construction Estimators prepare and deliver estimates and cost plans for construction projects up to the tender settlement stage.

title: Plumbing Inspectors
description: Plumbing Inspectors inspect plumbing work to ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations.

title: Surveying and Spatial Science Technicians
description: Surveying or Spatial Science Technicians collect, record and evaluate spatial information and prepare databases, maps, charts and plans in support of Surveyors, Cartographers or Other Spatial Scientists.

title: Other Architectural, Building and Surveying Technicians
description: Other Architectural, Building and Surveying Technicians includes jobs like Roof Truss Detailer, and Structural Steel Detailer.

title: Civil Engineering Draftspersons
description: Civil Engineering Draftspersons prepare detailed drawings and plans for civil engineering work in support of Civil Engineering Professionals and Engineering Technologists.

title: Civil Engineering Technicians
description: Civil Engineering Technicians conduct tests of construction materials, prepare sketches and tabulations, and assist in estimating costs in support of Civil Engineering Professionals and Engineering Technologists.

title: Electrical Engineering Draftspersons
description: Electrical Engineering Draftspersons prepare detailed drawings and plans of electrical installations and circuitry in support of Electrical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.

title: Electrical Engineering Technicians
description: Electrical Engineering Technicians conduct tests of electrical systems, prepare charts and tabulations, and assist in estimating costs in support of Electrical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.

title: Electronic Engineering Draftspersons
description: Electronic Engineering Draftspersons prepare detailed drawings and plans of electronic engineering work in support of Electronics Engineers and Engineering Technologists.

title: Electronic Engineering Technicians
description: Electronic Engineering Technicians conduct tests of electronic systems, collect and analyse data, and assemble circuitry in support of Electronics Engineers and Engineering Technologists.

title: Paper and Pulp Mill Workers
description: Paper and Pulp Mill Workers perform routine tasks in paper and pulp mills, such as placing logs onto conveyors for chipping, and loading woodchip and pulp for processing.

title: Sawmill and Timber Yard Workers
description: Sawmill or Timber Yard Workers perform routine tasks in sawmill or timber yards, such as sorting and stacking timber, assisting timber machinists, assembling orders, and racking offcuts.

title: Wood and Wood Products Factory Workers
description: Wood and Wood Products Factory Workers perform routine tasks in wood processing and timber product factories, such as placing logs on equipment and conveyors, assisting with measuring and cutting of materials, and setting up and operating plant equipment.

title: Cement and Concrete Plant Workers
description: Cement and Concrete Plant Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing cement and concrete products, such as greasing and assembling concrete moulds, holding reinforcing steel in position during concrete pours, stripping moulds from dried concrete products, and finishing products.

title: Chemical Plant Workers
description: Chemical Plant Workers perform routine tasks in chemical processing plants, such as delivering materials to processing areas, dumping ingredients into hoppers, operating machines to heat, cool and agitate chemical solutions, filling and fastening covers on containers, and attaching labels and information on products.

title: Clay Processing Factory Workers
description: Clay Processing Factory Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing clay and ceramic products, such as loading clay into machines, stacking products on kiln cars, pallets and trolleys, and moving kiln cars and trolleys to and from kilns, dryers, sorting, storage and shipping areas.

title: Fabric and Textile Factory Workers
description: Fabric and Textile Factory Workers perform routine tasks in fabric and textile factories, such as cutting canvas, upholstery and curtain fabrics, delivering materials to machines, operating automatic machines using computerised patterns, pressing partially completed and finished garments, and inspecting and finishing completed garments.

title: Footwear Factory Workers
description: Footwear Factory Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing footwear, such as basic hand cutting of shoe components, delivering materials to machines, and inspecting and finishing completed footwear.

title: Glass Processing Workers
description: Glass Processing Workers perform routine tasks in manufacturing glassware, such as setting up, adjusting and repairing automatic machines and equipment, and checking weight of glassware.

title: Hide and Skin Processing Workers
description: Hide and Skin Processing Workers perform routine tasks in tanning and finishing leather, hides and skins.

title: Recycling Workers
description: Recycling Workers perform routine tasks in recycling facilities, such as sorting, packing and storing plastics, glass, paper, metals and other recyclable materials which have been collected from household, commercial and industrial premises in preparation for use in creating new products.

title: Factory Process Workers (not covered elsewhere)
description: Factory Process Workers (not covered elsewhere) includes jobs like Sheltered Workshop Worker.

title: Fruit and Nut Farm Workers
description: Fruit or Nut Farm Workers perform routine tasks on fruit or nut farms, such as cultivating and fertilising soil, and planting, irrigating and pruning crops. They may spray chemicals on crops to treat disease and pests.

title: Fruit and Nut Pickers
description: Fruit or Nut Pickers harvest fruit and nuts and prepare produce for distribution.

title: Grain, Oilseed and Pasture Farm Workers
description: Grain, Oilseed or Pasture Farm Workers perform routine tasks on grain, oilseed protein, or pasture farms, such as cultivating and fertilising soil, and planting and irrigating crops. They may spray chemicals on crops to treat diseases and pests.

title: Vegetable Farm Workers
description: Vegetable Farm Workers perform routine tasks on vegetable farms or market gardens, such as cultivating and fertilising soil, and planting and irrigating crops. They may spray chemicals on crops to treat diseases and pests.

title: Vegetable Pickers
description: Vegetable Pickers harvest vegetables and prepare produce for distribution.

title: Vineyard Workers
description: Vineyard Workers perform routine tasks on vineyards, such as cultivating and fertilising soil, planting, training and pruning vines, and picking grapes.

title: Mushroom Pickers
description: Mushroom Pickers harvest mushrooms and prepare produce for distribution.

title: Other Crop Farm Workers
description: Other Crop Farm Workers includes jobs like Coffee Plantation Worker, Flower Buncher or Picker, Hop Farm Worker, Lavender Farm Worker, Sugar Cane Planter, Tea Plantation Worker, Tea Tree Farm Worker, and Turf Farm Worker.

title: Forestry Workers
description: Forestry Workers assist with cultivating, maintaining and protecting forests.

title: Logging Assistants
description: Logging Assistants assist with logging, felling and sawing of trees in forests.

title: Tree Fallers
description: Tree Fallers fell trees in forests, and trim and saw them into logs.

title: Garden Labourers
description: Garden Labourers assist in cultivating and maintaining gardens.

title: Nursery Hands (Horticulture)
description: Nursery Hands (Horticulture) assist in propagating, cultivating and harvesting plants in horticultural nurseries.

title: Beef Cattle Farm Workers
description: Beef Cattle Farm Workers perform routine tasks on beef cattle farms, such as feeding, mustering and moving cattle, and assisting with animal husbandry.

title: Dairy Cattle Farm Workers
description: Dairy Cattle Farm Workers perform routine tasks on dairy farms, such as herding and milking cattle.

title: Mixed Livestock Farm Workers
description: Mixed Livestock Farm Workers perform routine tasks on mixed livestock farms, such as moving, feeding and counting livestock, and assisting with animal husbandry.

title: Poultry Farm Workers
description: Poultry Farm Workers perform routine tasks on poultry farms, such as collecting eggs and placing them in incubators, providing poultry with feed and water, and disinfecting hatcheries to prevent disease.

title: Sheep Farm Workers
description: Sheep Farm Workers perform routine tasks on a sheep farm, such as herding sheep into pens in preparation for branding, shearing, crutching, dipping and yarding for sale.

title: Stablehands
description: Stablehands assist with handling of horses and maintaining and cleaning stables.

title: Wool Handlers
description: Wool Handlers regulate the flow of sheep to be shorn, keep the shearing shed clean and tidy, and assist with wool clip preparation.

title: Other Livestock Farm Workers
description: Other Livestock Farm Workers  includes jobs like Deer Farm Worker, Emu Farm Worker, Goat Herder, Ostrich Farm Worker, and Piggery Worker.

title: Hunter-Trappers
description: Hunter-Trappers hunt, trap and shoot animals for food, pelts, research, and pest control.

title: Pest Controllers
description: Pest Controllers apply pest management techniques to control invertebrate and insect pests inside and outside domestic, commercial and industrial premises.

title: Farm, Forestry and Garden Workers (not covered elsewhere)
description: Farm, Forestry and Garden Workers includes jobs like Bush Regenerator, Indoor Plant Technician, Irrigationist, Kelp or Seagrass Gatherer, Seed Collector, and Weed Controller.

title: Pastrycook's Assistants
description: Pastrycook Assistants assist Pastrycooks by performing routine tasks in the kitchen such as preparing ingredients, and cleaning and storing equipment.

title: Other Food Trades Assistants
description: Other Food Trades Assistantsinclude jobs like Butcher's Assistant, Chef's Assistant, and Cook's Assistant.

title: Freight Handlers (Rail or Road)
description: Freight Handlers (Rail or Road) load and unload freight trucks, containers and rail cars.

title: Truck Driver's Offsiders
description: Truck Driver Offsiders load and unload trucks and containers.

title: Waterside Workers
description: Waterside Workers transfer cargo between ships and other forms of transport or storage facilities.

title: Deck Hands
description: Deck Hands perform maintenance and lookout tasks aboard ships.

title: Fishing Hands
description: Fishing Hands catch fish, crustacea and molluscs using nets, pots, lines and traps in ocean and inland waters.

title: Motor Vehicle Parts and Accessories Fitters (General)
description: Motor Vehicle Parts and Accessories Fitters (General) fit and replace parts and accessories on motor vehicles.

title: Autoglaziers
description: Autoglaziers repair and replace windscreens and side and rear glass in motor vehicles.

title: Exhaust and Muffler Repairers
description: Exhaust and Muffler Repairers repair and replace defective exhaust and muffler systems in motor vehicles.

title: Radiator Repairers
description: Radiator Repairers repair and replace radiators and cooling systems in motor vehicles.

title: Tyre Fitters
description: Tyre Fitters fit, repair and replace tyres on motor vehicles.

title: Printer's Assistants
description: Printers' Assistants perform routine tasks in the production of printed materials.

title: Printing Table Workers
description: Printing Table Workers operate bindery machines and perform manual binding and finishing of books and printed products.

title: Bicycle Mechanics
description: Bicycle Mechanics repair and adjust bicycles, and assemble bicycle kits.

title: Car Park Attendants
description: Car Park Attendants operate and maintain car parking facilities by guarding cars in parking areas and collecting fees at car park entry or exit points. They may drive and park cars, and operate boom gates.

title: Crossing Supervisors
description: Crossing Supervisors assist children, disabled and other pedestrians to cross roads by stopping traffic and ensuring all pedestrians have crossed safely before allowing traffic to flow through the crossing.

title: Electrical and Telecommunications Trades Assistants
description: Electrical or Telecommunications Trades Assistants assist Electrotechnology and Telecommunications Trades Workers to install and maintain electrical and telecommunications systems.

title: Leaflet and Newspaper Deliverers
description: Leaflet or Newspaper Deliverers collect leaflets or newspapers from collection points and deliver them to homes in a specified area.

title: Mechanic's Assistants
description: Mechanics' Assistants assist Motor Mechanics to replace and repair worn and defective parts, re-assemble mechanical components, change oil and filters, and perform other routine mechanical tasks.

title: Railways Assistants
description: Railways' Assistants assist with operating and maintaining facilities at railway stations by updating platform indicators showing train times and destinations, collecting and checking passenger tickets, giving signals for train departures, and cleaning station facilities.

title: Sign Erectors
description: Sign Erectors erect and install signs, and clean signs and their sites after installation.

title: Ticket Collectors and Ushers
description: Ticket Collector or Ushers collect tickets or admission passes and usher patrons to their seats at an entertainment, sporting or recreational venue, prepare the venue before an event and lock up premises afterwards.

title: Trolley Collectors
description: Trolley Collectors collect supermarket trolleys from car parks and other areas, and return them to the supermarket by hand or trailer. They may drive a small tractor to tow the trolleys.

title: Road Traffic Controllers
description: Road Traffic Controllers manually direct road traffic and pedestrian flows on, near, or adjacent to roads during road closures or part road closures due to construction, maintenance or roadside works; public events; or emergency responses using signs and devices to ensure the safety of workers, motorists and pedestrians.

title: Labourers (not covered elsewhere)
description: Other Labourers (not covered elsewhere) includes jobs like Bowling Alley Attendant, Grip, Milk Runner, Racecourse Barrier Attendant, Stagehand, Studio Hand, and Swimming Pool Serviceperson.
